basic_profile.bio: Based in the Pacific Northwest, I've been an avid Redditor for a decade. My journey began with a keen interest in tabletop RPGs, particularly Shadowrun, which led to a fascination with speculative fiction and world-building. I work as a software engineer, focusing on cybersecurity solutions. When I'm not coding, you can find me experimenting with new recipes or diving into the latest horror movie reviews on Cinemassacre. I'm single and usually browse Reddit during late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, my professional focus has been on cybersecurity. I've accumulated a wealth of knowledge through both formal education and years of hands-on experience in the field, including attending numerous cybersecurity conferences and workshops. Additionally, I've self-taught myself the intricacies of game design and culinary arts through online courses.
